I'll start by loading the browser tools, then use the Steam page you already have open to find the Steam Deck top-played game and filter its reviews.**Slay the Spire 2** is the top game on Steam’s Steam Deck Top Played chart for the past year. On the storefront, Store → Charts → Steam Deck, with the range set to past year, it is the first title. Stardew Valley, Hades II, Baldur’s Gate 3, and Megabonk follow it.

It is an Early Access deckbuilder from Mega Crit. Overall, English reviews are Very Positive (72,138). Across all languages there are 189,619 reviews, scored Mixed, and the last 3,389 recent reviews are Mostly Positive.

The review list is filtered to **Over 100 hours** (playtime when the review was written) and **Played mostly on Steam Deck**. On that list, long-time Deck players are mostly positive, with one clear complaint about a boss.

| Player | Verdict | Time | Posted | What they said |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aurelian | Not Recommended | 269.5 hrs (216.6 at review) | Sep 23 | Calls the Aeonglass boss poorly designed and run-mandating; says the rest is a great improvement on the first game. 10 found it helpful. |
| firehands11 | Recommended | 240.9 hrs (206 at review) | Oct 21 | Steep learning curve, then hours of fun. |
| kooolm | Recommended | 325.6 hrs (261.4 at review) | Oct 10 | “I've played it a couple times and it's not bad.” |
| Zyararara | Recommended | 163.9 hrs (152.9 at review) | Oct 17 | “Another absolute classic, a must play for any and all roguelike enjoyers.” |
| 123djvolschenk | Recommended | 106.7 hrs (106.6 at review) | Oct 17 | Cards either make them very angry or happy, with nothing in between. |
| WHAT THE YOTS | Recommended | 269.3 hrs (213.7 at review) | Oct 8 | “the classic of the genre, back to redefine excellence once again.” |
| bernhard.matthieu | Recommended | 127.8 hrs | Nov 5 | “A genre defining game that sticks hours after hours!” |
| jooshua | Recommended | 127.1 hrs | Oct 26 | “Still haven't beaten the jaw worm.” |
| chr_graf | Recommended | 444.6 hrs (411 at review) | Oct 13 | “Love it thx to all in the dev team.” |
| Raymonddog | Recommended | 160.3 hrs (140.5 at review) | Oct 22 | Simple to understand and enjoyable to try to master. |

Shorter reviews on the same filtered page: Isocle (145.1 hrs, Nov 3, “Goated with the sauce”), shameronium (118.8 hrs, Nov 3, “Shiv” repeated), Daiselaine (138.4 hrs, Oct 31, “like!!”), Cbwaters (135.6 hrs, Oct 26, “it is just good”), and xmadrussianx (187.9 hrs, Oct 21, “Love this game!”).
